subject: util/ranger: support use `like` to build range for new collation columns (#48522)
summary: Reviewed planner util/ranger changes that convert string points to collation sort keys so LIKE can produce index ranges under new collations. No remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues relative to the first parent after checking later upstream history; the main High-risk partition-pruning collation regression present in this commit is gated/fixed on upstream/master, so it is not reported as an outstanding finding here.
